law.authority: the configured authority manufactures and selects stock recipes; filesystem discovery cannot admit one
law.hierarchy: every non-source recipe names an earlier-scope parent in the same source profile and sibling ordinals are unique
law.semantics: every recipe binds the shared modality-agnostic semantic-segmentation law plus exact grammar codec lowering recomposition loss correction and conformance witnesses
law.perfcache: each declared derived plane binds exact key value dependency generation verification invalidation and rebuild law and can only accelerate its owning canonical recipe
law.canonical: catalog identity is invariant to caller order and covers every recipe and perfcache declaration
